# Element Transitions

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

## struct AddRemoveTransition

An added item grows from 90 % and fades in after the items it displaces have moved. A deleted one shrinks to 90 % and fades out, and the rest close the gap.

## struct ContentTransition

New content slides in from the offset over 500 ms and fades in over 170 ms after 50 ms. Outgoing content fades out in 50 ms.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offset_x` | `float` | `0.0f` | Start x offset of incoming content, DIPs. |
| `offset_y` | `float` | `28.0f` | Start y offset of incoming content, DIPs. |

## struct EntranceTransition

An element entering the tree slides in from the given offset while it fades in, over 667 ms along (0.1,0.9)-(0.2,1). With staggering on, the elements that enter together start 35 ms apart.

Example: 
```cpp
window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing              = 8,
    .children_transitions = {ui::EntranceTransition{.stagger = true}},
    .content              = {ui::Text{.text = "First"}, ui::Text{.text = "Second"}},
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offset_x` | `float` | `0.0f` | Start x offset from the final position, DIPs. |
| `offset_y` | `float` | `28.0f` | Start y offset from the final position, DIPs. |
| `stagger` | `bool` | `false` | Start elements entering together 35 ms apart. |

## struct NavigationTransition

An entry of a navigation frame's content transitions (`set_content_transitions()`). It animates navigation with the [PageTransition](namespace-ui.md#pagetransition) passed to `navigate()`, or with this default when none was passed.

Example: 
```cpp
auto frame = std::make_unique<ui::NavigationFrameControl>();
frame->set_content_transitions({ui::NavigationTransition{
    .default_transition = ui::ZoomPageTransition{}}});
frame->navigate([] { return std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Details"); }); // zooms in
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default_transition` | `std::optional<PageTransition>` |  | Used when navigate() is given no transition. Unset uses [RisePageTransition](navigation-transitions.md#struct-risepagetransition). |

## struct PopupTransition

An opening popup slides in from the offset and fades in. A closing one fades out in 83 ms.

Example: 
```cpp
auto popup = std::make_unique<ui::PopupControl>();
popup->set_child_transitions({ui::PopupTransition{.offset_y = 20.0f}});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offset_x` | `float` | `0.0f` | Start x offset of the opening popup, DIPs. |
| `offset_y` | `float` | `40.0f` | Start y offset of the opening popup, DIPs. |

## struct RepositionTransition

An element that layout moves glides from where it was, over 367 ms. Staggering, on by default, starts the elements moved together 33 ms apart.

Example: 
```cpp
auto item = std::make_unique<ui::BorderControl>();
item->set_transitions({ui::RepositionTransition{.stagger = false}});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stagger` | `bool` | `true` | Delay elements moved together 33 ms apart. |
